PREMIUM SSD FOR PS5 PCIe Gen4 x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

Enjoy next-gen performance with the PREMIUM SSD FOR PS5 PCIe Gen4x4 M.2 2280 solid state drive (SSD). Sporting the latest PCIe Gen4 x4 interface and a host of other capabilities, this SSD is capable of reaching blazing-fast read/write speeds of up to 7,400/6,800/MB per second.

Features Ordering Information

● Work with PS5 Capacity Model Number EAN Code 
● Read speed up to 6,100MB/s for PS5 1TB APSFG-1T-CSUS 4711085936967 
● Capacity up to 2TB 2TB APSFG-1T-CSUS 4711085936974 
● Heat sink reduces temp. by up to 20% 
● Ultra-fast PCIe Gen4x4 interface 
● Compliant with NVMe 1.4 
● R/W speed up to 7,400/6,800MB/s for PC/laptop 
● SLC Caching and DRAM cache buffer 
● Advanced LDPC ECC Technology 
● E2E Data Protection and RAID Engine 
● AES 256-bit encryption support 
● Compact M.2 2280 form factor – ideal for gaming 
and high-end desktops 

Specifications

● Capacity: 1TB / 2TB ● Dimensions (L x W x H): 
● Controller: InnoGrit IG5236A1 80 x 22 x 4.3mm (with heat sink) 
● NAND Flash: 3D NAND 80 x 22 x 3.3mm (without heat sink) 
● Interface: PCIe Gen4 x4 ● Weight: 
● Form Factor: M.2 2280 10g / 0.35oz (with heat sink) 
● Sequential read/write (Max.): 
Up to 7,400/6,800MB/s (PC/laptop) 

7g / 0.24oz (without heat sink) ● Terabytes Written (TBW)(Max. capacity): 1480TB Read speed up to 6,100MB/s (PS5) ● MTBF: 2,000,000 hours ● 4K random read/write IOPS (Max.): 750K/750K ● Warranty: 5-year limited ● Operating Temperature: 0°C-70°C ● Certifications: CE, FCC, BSMI, CAN, Prop 65, ROHS ● Storage Temperature: -40°C-85°C ● Shock Resistance: 1500G/0.5ms
